-- A2. continuation value V(n) = E[final score | still alive with n alive] and the duel threshold it implies --
p*(n) = (V(n) - (16-n)) / (V(n-1) - (16-n));  P* = (p*/(1-p*))^(1/3) (panel 1 mapping p = P^3/(1+P^3))
